title: Nutty Kenyan Coconut Stew
description: A hearty and comforting Kenyan stew made with coconut flakes and nuts, perfect for a sick day. This low-calorie-friendly dish is cooked in a traditional ttukbaegi earthenware pot.
instructions: Heat the melted coconut oil in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the chopped peanuts, coconut flakes, vegetable broth, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Remove the pot from the heat and let it cool slightly before serving.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional coconut flakes and peanuts if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
